Brazil's Lucas Paqueta Injured, Doubtful for World Cup Knockout Stage

Brazilian footballer Lucas Paqueta has sustained a thigh muscle injury. The injury makes him doubtful for Brazil's upcoming Round of 16 match in the FIFA World Cup. This is considered a significant setback for the team.
